name: dsh-cookie-pruner
description: DSH 桌面端 dsh-auth-* cookie 累积（HTTP 431 / Web authentication failed 启动崩溃）缓解插件。限制 cookie 生命周期、自动清理最旧的认证 cookie，并在左下角「账户 → 设置」里新增一个「Cookie 清理」分区，显示当前条数并支持一键清理（保留最近 5 条）。 / Mitigates the DSH desktop dsh-auth-* cookie pile-up (HTTP 431 / Web authentication failed) bug: caps cookie lifetime, auto-prunes oldest auth cookies, and adds a "Cookie 清理" section in the bottom-left account → Settings dialog showing the live count with a real one-click clean button (keep newest 5).
